bullets_en: J&K Congress leader Peerzada Mohammad Sayeed dies at 73.
No need for CBI probe in Kallakurichi TVK MLA case: Thirumavalavan.
Voting for Tripura civic polls underway amid tight security.
VChief Minister inaugurates care home for elderly men.
Mamata's brother seeks FIR against nephew Abhishek over 'threats'.
bullets_ur: J&K Congress rehnuma Peerzada Mohammad Sayeed 73 saal ki umar mein inteqal kar gaye.
Kallakurichi TVK MLA ke case mein CBI tehqeeqat ki zaroorat nahi: Thirumavalavan.

Mamata ke bhai ne 'dhamkiyon' par bhatijay Abhishek ke khilaf FIR ki darkhwast kar di.
